                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lvwangshuOI/p/23206388" title="发布于 2026-10-06 08:21">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">CF813D Two Melodies 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="cf813d-two-melodies-题解">CF813D Two Melodies 题解</h1>
<p>选<strong>两个非空、互不相交</strong>的子序列，各自满足"相邻音符相差 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 或模 <span class="math inline">\(7\)</span> 同余"，求长度和的最大值。<span class="math inline">\(n \le 5000\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(a_i \le 10^5\)</span>。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="1-朴素-dp">1. 朴素 DP：<span class="math inline">\(f[i][x][y]\)</span></h2>
<p>扫描到第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个音符，两条旋律末尾值为 <span class="math inline">\(x,y\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(0\)</span> 表示该旋律为空）时的最大总长度。扫到 <span class="math inline">\(v=a_{i+1}\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li>跳过：<span class="math inline">\(f[i+1][x][y] \gets \max(f[i+1][x][y],\ f[i][x][y])\)</span></li>
<li>接第一条（<span class="math inline">\(x=0\)</span> 或 <span class="math inline">\(x\sim v\)</span>）：<span class="math inline">\(f[i+1][v][y] \gets f[i][x][y]+1\)</span></li>
<li>接第二条（<span class="math inline">\(y=0\)</span> 或 <span class="math inline">\(y\sim v\)</span>）：<span class="math inline">\(f[i+1][x][v] \gets f[i][x][y]+1\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>状态数 <span class="math inline">\(n\cdot10^{10}\)</span>，开不出来。</p>
<h2 id="2-消掉-">2. 消掉 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(g[x][y]\)</span></h2>
<p>三个转移的合法性判断<strong>都不含 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span></strong>，它只表示"扫到哪"；而任意状态都能靠"跳过"传到最后一层，所以整维滚掉。</p>
<p>剩下 <span class="math inline">\(10^{10}\)</span> 个状态，仍太大。</p>
<h2 id="3-关键观察">3. 关键观察</h2>
<p>最后一层里，任何非初始状态都满足<strong>两个末尾至少有一个等于 <span class="math inline">\(v=a_n\)</span></strong> —— 一个下标不能同时进两条旋律。于是只需维护"以 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 为端点"的转移：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[g'[v][y] = \max\Big(g[v][y],\ 1+\max_{x=0 \text{ 或 } x\sim v} g[x][y]\Big)
\]</div><p></p><h2 id="4-陷阱直接开全局桶是错的">4. 陷阱：直接开全局桶是错的</h2>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(\text{best}[t] = \max\{g[x][y] \mid x=t \text{ 或 } y=t\}\)</span>，转移看似只需 <span class="math inline">\(1+\max(\text{best}[v\pm1],\ \text{bestMod}[v\bmod7])\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(O(1)\)</span> 完事。<strong>但这是错的。</strong></p>
<p><strong>结论：桶只压缩了"用来判定相容的那一维"，配对信息必须留着 → 钉住一个端点。</strong></p>
<h2 id="5-钉住端点">5. 钉住端点：<span class="math inline">\(dp[i][j]\)</span></h2>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[dp[i][j] = \text{两条旋律末尾分别在位置 } i,j\ (i&lt;j) \text{ 时的最大总长度}
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(dp\)</span> 对 <span class="math inline">\(i,j\)</span> <strong>对称</strong>，"哪条是第一"无意义。令 <span class="math inline">\(a[0]=0\)</span> 为虚拟位置，则 <span class="math inline">\(dp[0][j]\)</span> = 以 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 结尾的最长<strong>单</strong>旋律长度。</p>
<p>位置维度在这里足够：<span class="math inline">\(i&lt;j\)</span> 保证两条旋律不交叉，转移来源 <span class="math inline">\(k&lt;j\)</span> 保证接在末尾之后。</p>
<p>设第二条旋律倒数第二个元素在 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(k&lt;j\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(k\ne i\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(a[k]\sim a[j]\)</span>）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[dp[i][j] = 1 + \max\Big(\{\,dp[0][i]\,\} \cup \{\,dp[k][i] \mid k&lt;i,\ a[k]\sim a[j]\,\} \cup \{\,dp[i][k] \mid i&lt;k&lt;j,\ a[k]\sim a[j]\,\}\Big)
\]</div><p></p><p>朴素 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^3)\)</span>，超时。</p>
<h2 id="6-开桶--前缀优化-">6. 开桶 + 前缀优化 <span class="math inline">\(\Rightarrow O(n^2)\)</span></h2>
<p>固定 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 从 <span class="math inline">\(i+1\)</span> 递增。转移对 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 的枚举<strong>只用 <span class="math inline">\(a[k]\)</span> 的值</strong>，位置范围限制已由枚举顺序保证，故可开两桶：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\text{best}[v]\)</span>：另一个端点值为 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的最优</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\text{bestMod}[r]\)</span>：另一个端点值 <span class="math inline">\(\equiv r \pmod 7\)</span> 的最优</li>
</ul>
<p>一轮 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 的生命周期：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>开局</strong>：把 <span class="math inline">\(k\in[0,i)\)</span> 的 <span class="math inline">\(dp[k][i]\)</span> 按 <span class="math inline">\(a[k]\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(a[k]\bmod 7\)</span> 入桶（覆盖第二项）</li>
<li><strong>扫描中</strong>：每算出 <span class="math inline">\(dp[i][j']\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(i&lt;j'&lt;j\)</span>）<strong>立刻入桶</strong>（这就是前缀优化，第三项自动被覆盖）</li>
<li><strong>收尾</strong>：清桶</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[dp[i][j] = 1 + \max\Big(dp[0][i],\ \text{best}[a[j]-1],\ \text{best}[a[j]+1],\ \text{bestMod}[a[j]\bmod 7]\Big)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>答案</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(\max\{dp[i][j] \mid 1\le i&lt;j\le n\}\)</span>。<span class="math inline">\(i\ge1\)</span> 保证第一条非空，<span class="math inline">\(n\ge2\)</span> 保证答案 <span class="math inline">\(\ge2\)</span>.</p>
<h2 id="ac-code">AC code</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const int N = 5005;
const int MAXA = 100005;

int n, a[N], dp[N][N];
int val[MAXA], mod[7];

int main () {
    ios::sync_with_stdio (false);
    cin.tie (0);

    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i ++) cin &gt;&gt; a[i];

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; i ++) {
        for (int k = 0; k &lt; 7; k ++) mod[k] = 0;
        // 开局：k &lt; i 的 dp[k][i] 入桶
        for (int k = 0; k &lt; i; k ++) {
            val[a[k]] = max (val[a[k]], dp[k][i]);
            mod[a[k] % 7] = max (mod[a[k] % 7], dp[k][i]);
        }
        for (int j = i + 1; j &lt;= n; j++) {
            int res = dp[0][i] + 1;
            res = max (res, val[a[j] - 1] + 1);
            res = max (res, val[a[j] + 1] + 1);
            res = max (res, mod[a[j] % 7] + 1);
            dp[i][j] = res;
            // 先算再入桶，否则 a[j] 被自己用两次；这一步即前缀优化
            val[a[j]] = max (val[a[j]], dp[i][j]);
            mod[a[j] % 7] = max (mod[a[j] % 7], dp[i][j]);
            if (i &gt; 0) ans = max (ans, dp[i][j]);
        }
        for (int k = 0; k &lt;= n; k++) val[a[k]] = 0;
    }

    cout &lt;&lt; ans &lt;&lt; "\n";
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="复杂度">复杂度</h2>
<p>时间 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>，空间 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2+A)\)</span></p>
